sources.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
sources.snippet: WeVisOne-VL is a vision-language foundation model that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception — detection, referring, counting, pointing, OCR, segmentation and alpha matting — through structured next-token prediction.
